task.summary: Friction-free member onboarding, auth, and responsive UI: - Responsive landing page with emerald/indigo ambient lighting and mobile-first design. - Frictionless member registration & login using phone numbers (no passwords required for church members). - Added localStorage form draft persistence to prevent data loss on mobile browser reloads. - Created dedicated admin login route with role verification. - Wrapped search params in Suspense and configured Supabase RLS policies for smooth database inserts. - Included Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights in root layout.

Complete member portal, dynamic analytics & offline sync: - Fully responsive member dashboard (`app/member/dashboard/page.tsx`) with real-time profile management and editing. - Integrated dedicated Sunday School Department Support and Byte & Security technical support cards. - Implemented dynamic monthly attendance analytics grid and stats toggle that automatically adjusts for months with 4 or 5 Sundays. - Built robust offline-first attendance queuing (`localStorage` fallback) with automatic background syncing via `OfflineSyncProvider` and `navigator.onLine` listeners. - Resolved TypeScript promise handling (`void` prefixes) and linter warnings across auth, layout, and sync utilities.

Fix(security): resolve admin RLS recursion error and add isolated admin_profiles schema: - Admin login page set. - Super Admin created initialized in Supabase. - Fix async and hydration errors in login and register for members.
Add gender/email fields, guest edit/delete, dynamic attendance states, and persistent QR state
Fix(build): defer new Date() state initialization to useEffect to resolve Vercel pre-render error
Change to url for QR Code
QR CODE: Added livestream to get live view of the code

Modularize dashboard into independent components, add mobile responsiveness, custom modals, and dynamic date/month filtering - Modularize Admin Dashboard into independent components inside components/admin/ - Extract Sunday School Analytics Engine into components/admin/analytics/AttendanceTrends.tsx - Move Attendance Legend banner from OverviewAnalytics into MemberRoster header - Add mobile-first collapsible dropdowns for Key Metrics and Demographic Split in OverviewAnalytics - Update MemberRoster with dynamic month selection (0 hardcoded dates) and responsive mobile card view - Update GuestManagement with calendar date picker, name search filter, colorful options, and mobile card view - Update QrGenerator with live ticking countdown timer (MM:SS) and expiration badge - Update StaffDirectory with custom confirmation delete modal, super admin restrictions, and 5-admin account limit check - Ensure foreign key constraint independence for admin profiles without Supabase Auth ties

Comprehensive update on profiles, auth, birthdays & UX loaders: - Database & Profiles: Made email optional in profiles table, stored date_of_birth as TEXT to support flexible year-agnostic (MM-DD) and full YYYY-MM-DD formats. - Auth Logic: Implemented .or() queries across phone_number and whatsapp_number for seamless login and registration without duplicate loops. - Birthday Directory: Added full 12-month accordion layout, collapsible active month Spotlight Hero with live countdown badges, and robust year-agnostic date parsing. - UI & UX: Created a reusable LoadingSpinner component and integrated it across all member, guest, admin, and check-in portals. - Navigation: Implemented history-aware router.back() navigation across portals to preserve context when returning from sub-pages.
Implement automated session upsert and fix member dashboard attendance stats
